outline:
以整合行銷傳播為基礎，分析產品之廣告與推廣組合機會，進而發展全傳播之策略與企劃，意圖培養學生邏輯思考、資料判讀、廣告企劃分析之能力，亦包括各種產業之企劃工作。

The management of advertising includes the establishment advertising objectives, budget determination, strategy and message creation, determination of message distribution, and evaluation of the results.

The topics include: circumstance, consumer, commodity, communication, cost, channel and corporate, advertising Media, Integrated Marketing Communication, Media planning, Advertising effectiveness and so on.
